audit.summary: The 320×480 ad unit has critical readability and visual hierarchy issues. The product image is too dark and lacks sufficient contrast; the overlaid text 'À 4Z POUR UN JOUR' on the car is nearly illegible. The CTA button placement is good, but the overall design needs contrast and legibility fixes to meet accessibility standards.

findings.issue: Product image car is too dark; overlaid white text 'À 4Z POUR UN JOUR' on vehicle is barely legible against the dark blue car body and background. Insufficient contrast for readability.
findings.fix_hint: Add a semi-transparent dark overlay or text shadow to the 'À 4Z POUR UN JOUR' text element. Use CSS text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.9) or place text in a semi-transparent background box (rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) with padding for contrast. Alternatively, reposition text to a higher-contrast zone or increase font-weight.

findings.issue: Hero section (car + background) feels visually cramped between headline and CTA. The product image dominates without clear visual separation.
findings.fix_hint: Add 12–16px vertical spacing (margin-top or gap) between the 'Libérez chaque km' section and the product image container to improve breathing room and hierarchy.

audit.regeneration_prompt: 1. Add text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); or background rgba(0,0,0,0.4) with padding to the 'À 4Z POUR UN JOUR' overlay text for legibility. 2. Increase vertical gap between headline/subtext and product image by 12–16px via margin or gap property. 3. Verify all other hex colors match the BYD palette (#EC1C24 red, #FFFFFF white, #0A0A0A dark, etc.).
